proposals.issue_title: Budget Burnout Protection for Runware and Paid APIs
proposals.current_pain_description: Using Runware PAYG with a 20€ limit is risky on GitHub Actions. A faulty loop or concurrent GHA triggers could drain the entire 20€ credit in a few minutes, halting all image generation for the month.
proposals.proposed_fix: Implement a centralized cost-tracking decorator in Python. Save a lightweight state file (`.github/outputs/budget_state.json`) containing `daily_spent` and `monthly_spent`. If the threshold (e.g., 1€/day or 20€/month) is exceeded, the API client immediately raises a hard exception and skips further generation, falling back to Pollinations.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Zero risk of financial overspend; automated protection against loop bugs on free runner environments.

proposals.issue_title: GHA Shared IP Blockage and 429/403 Failures
proposals.current_pain_description: GitHub Actions runners share public IP ranges. Public APIs without API keys (AI Horde, Gemini free tier, Hugging Face) often return 403 or 429 errors because other GHA users have exhausted the rate limits.
proposals.proposed_fix: Enforce a strict 'API-Key Only' policy for production pipelines. For free tiers (Together AI, Cloudflare Workers), require a secret-based token. For Pollinations, use unique query parameters to bypass naive IP rate-limiting, and implement an exponential backoff retry wrapper specifically tailored for GHA environments.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Reduces pipeline failure rates from ~50% down to <5% on GHA runners.

proposals.issue_title: Silent Failures of GHA Cron Jobs
proposals.current_pain_description: When a cron pipeline fails on GHA, Hugo only finds out if he manually checks the GitHub Actions tab on his phone. This leads to silent system downtime.
proposals.proposed_fix: Add a post-step in GitHub Actions workflows that sends a Telegram message or Discord webhook notification ONLY on failure, containing the run URL and the last 5 lines of error logs. It uses a free, private webhook.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Eliminates manual pipeline checking; reduces mean-time-to-repair from days to minutes.

proposals.issue_title: High Image Shading & Greyscale in Coloring Books
proposals.current_pain_description: Raw prompts sent to FLUX or SDXL often generate images with grey gradients, heavy shadows, or complex 3D rendering. These are un-colorable and look highly unprofessional in physical books.
proposals.proposed_fix: Inject a strict prompt-template wrapper. Force negative prompting (if supported by the model) and append deterministic suffixes: 'pure black and white outline art, coloring page style, clean white background, zero grayscale shading, bold lines, high contrast, 2D vector graphic'. Add an automated PIL post-processing step to convert images to strict binary black/white using a high-pass filter.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Ensures 100% printable, high-quality coloring book pages that match professional Etsy/KDP standards.

proposals.issue_title: Massive Code Duplication Across 40+ Production Pipelines
proposals.current_pain_description: With over 40 pipelines (e.g., produce_iheart_v1 to v4, produce_literal_idioms, etc.), API keys, image downloads, error handling, and file-saving code are duplicated. A change in API structure requires editing dozens of files.
proposals.proposed_fix: Create a micro-package or local module `shared_core/` containing unified utility classes: `ImageGeneratorClient` (handling Together AI/Runware/Pollinations fallbacks), `KDPFormatter`, and `Logger`. Refactor active pipelines to import from this core.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Saves hours of maintenance; updates to APIs can be done in a single file instead of 40+ scripts.

proposals.current_pain_description: Designs generated for coloring books or SVG packs are processed and stored in isolation. They are never repurposed for Redbubble stickers, KDP low-content covers, or t-shirts, wasting potential ROI per generation.
proposals.proposed_fix: Develop a post-generation 'Cross-Pollination' dispatcher. When a high-quality SVG/PNG is approved, it automatically triggers sub-tasks: (1) Package as SVG for Etsy, (2) Apply transparent background for Redbubble stickers, (3) Place on a standard 6x9 cover template for KDP. Store all outputs in structured assets directories.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Multiplies asset surface area by 3x with zero extra image generation costs.

proposals.issue_title: Lack of Automated Mockups for POD and Digital Products
proposals.current_pain_description: To sell on Etsy, Cults3D, or Redbubble, Hugo must manually create listing images (mockups). On a mobile phone, this is tedious and limits listings to a crawl.
proposals.proposed_fix: Build a CLI-based mockup generator using Python Pillow (PIL). It overlays the generated PNG design onto transparent mockup templates (e.g., a blank t-shirt, a spiral book, or an iPad frame) with realistic opacity and blending modes. Save these automatically alongside the product assets.
proposals.estimated_value_unlocked: Unlocks zero-effort, ready-to-upload asset packs with listing mockups prepared directly from GHA.
